integrity: The infinite theorem is proved from the exact distance-two structure of complete multipartite graphs. Finite exhaustive checks are supplementary regression evidence and are not used as a proof of the infinite statement.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns ordinary vertex geodetic sets of connected complete multipartite graphs only.
The scalar geodetic number is not claimed as novel; broader prior algorithms compute that minimum on distance-hereditary graphs.
The accessible abstract of the original geodetic-polynomial paper does not list every family treated in its full text, leaving a residual bibliographic coverage risk.
A direct fetch of one later complete-multipartite strong-geodetic full text timed out; its surfaced abstract and section text concern the strong variant rather than the ordinary all-set polynomial.
title: Geodetic polynomial of complete multipartite graphs
